# Scientific Assurance Reports

openWEPP publishes scientific model-evaluation reports after their scientific
argument, quantitative results, limitations, reproduction materials, and exact
software realization have completed independent review and approval.

No scientific model-evaluation report has completed that publication process
yet. This neutral interim catalog does not mean that openWEPP processes lack
scientific evidence or that models awaiting synthesis have failed evaluation.
The public report portfolio is being rebuilt in the manuscript-first format so
readers can assess the evidence in the language and structure used in hydrology,
soil science, and environmental-model research.

Until reviewed reports are published, use the [model-science documentation](../README.md#model-science)
to understand each formulation, its rationale, implementation context, and
current limitations. Fitness for a particular watershed, decision, accuracy
need, and consequence of error remains the responsibility of the named user or
institution.
